1. 虚开用于抵扣税款发票 (falsely opening invoices for tax deduction). This is "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" as earlier examples. So crime: 虚开增值税专用发票罪 (falsely issuing VAT special invoices) maybe also "骗取税款罪"? In examples they label as "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So we can output that phrase.

2. 虚报注册资本 (false reporting of registered capital). This is a crime under Chinese law: "虚假出资" (false capital contribution) or "虚假出资罪". The typical charge is "虚假出资罪" (false capital contribution). In examples, they haven't had that yet. But we need to list appropriate crime(s). So combine: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;虚假出资.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票;虚假出资<eoa>
